يستقدمون (form X)
# يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ (yastaqdimūna) /jas.taq.di.muː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَقْدَمَ (istaqdama)
# يُسْتَقْدَمُونَ (yustaqdamūna) /jus.taq.da.muː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَقْدَمَ (istaqdama)
